weather_line: Fog in the hollows · ridgeline clearing by mid-morning · Jeep conditions: optimal

stories.headline: They Have Gone: Jeep Departs at First Light; the Table Is Bare; the Gorge Receives Them
body: At six forty-one this morning, before the fog had fully decided what it was doing, the enchanted Jeep rolled out of the drive and pointed itself toward the misty Appalachian highlands. Steve was at the wheel. Christine had the map — the circled waymarker now ringed twice, the second ring added in a different pencil at some point Thursday evening, in a hand that suggested the destination had been confirmed to her satisfaction.

Sources at the trailhead — a waymarker post, a corvid, and a small enchanted sign that reads CONDITIONS: SPIRITED — confirmed the Jeep's arrival at seven fifty-two. The fog on the ridge held until eight, then stepped aside in the manner of something that had been waiting to be asked politely. The trail beyond the gorge mouth was reported to be damp, narrow, root-strewn, and entirely the point.
The table at home is empty. The garage is latched. Lucy is in charge, which is to say that no one is in charge and Lucy is aware of this. The Jeep, by all accounts, has never been happier.

stories.headline: Household Governance Devolves Smoothly; Lucy Issues No Statement, Which Is the Statement
body: With both Christine and Steve off-grid and the Jeep's tail lights last seen rounding the lower bend at six forty-two, the household has entered what experts are calling 'a transitional administrative period.' Lucy has not convened any meetings. She has not needed to. She walked the perimeter at seven, assessed every room, and returned to the kitchen with the expression of someone who has found the books exactly as they left them.

Ellie spent the first twenty minutes of the expedition looking for Christine in the rooms Christine had recently vacated, which is to say all of them. She has since relocated to the sunny patch by the back window, where she fell asleep and is dreaming, apparently, of something that requires her feet to move. Jersey has installed himself on the vacated warm side of the sofa and has issued no formal statement regarding when he intends to move. Sources expect: never.

stories.headline: Saturday Reaches the Bank; Finds No One There; Continues on Its Way Untroubled
body: Gringotts opened its doors at nine o'clock this morning as required by the Wizarding Financial Calendar (Fourth Revision, still disputed). The Liaison Wing was unoccupied. The corridor clock chimed once, found no takers, and resumed its customary silence. The Duty Goblin logged the opening and closed the log immediately, which is the fastest he has closed it in eleven days.

Outstanding accounts are, by all available indicators, outstanding in the other sense: well ahead, fully annotated, with a margin of two working days' buffer built in as a matter of course. The Subcommittee, reached for comment, confirmed that Saturday presented no efficiency concerns whatsoever. They said this without apparent irony, which is progress of a kind.

stories.headline: Ministry Issues Saturday Bulletin Confirming Saturday; Notes That the Jeep Is 'Operating Within Observed Parameters'; Declines to Specify How It Is Observing
body: The Ministry of Magic released its Saturday morning bulletin at eight o'clock, confirming that Saturday is occurring and that the weekend has commenced in a manner consistent with prior weekends. The bulletin ran to four sentences, which is a personal record for brevity. Analysts attribute this to the absence of audit documentation to re-attach.

A footnote — unmarked, unsigned, appearing only in the copies distributed to the Expedition Monitoring Sub-office — noted that a Jeep matching registered highland specifications had been logged at a gorge-mouth waymarker at seven fifty-two and was proceeding, quote, 'into the fog in good order.' The Ministry clarified that it is not tracking the Jeep. The footnote remains.

familiars_corner: Lucy: conducted a full household audit between six forty-two and seven fifteen, found everything in order, and has been conspicuously comfortable with that finding ever since — perhaps too comfortable, say observers who have noticed that the biscuit cupboard is now facing a different direction than it was yesterday.

Ellie: discovered, after twenty minutes of room-by-room investigation, that Christine was not in the house — a conclusion she arrived at with complete surprise, as though she had not watched the Jeep leave from the front window at six forty-one.

Jersey: has determined that the warm side of the sofa reaches a peak temperature of approximately nine forty-five and has structured his entire Saturday around this fact; his schedule is, by any measure, full.
founding_editor_note: The gorge'll do what the gorge does — the Jeep'll be fine, the trail'll be fine, and if Steve hits a root wrong the suspension'll remind him I built the chassis bracing by hand and it's got opinions. — D.

in_brief.sport: Ridgeline Ramblers Association confirms the northern approach is 'character-building,' which is the polite word for steep; Christine has not asked for their opinion on the matter.
in_brief.forecast: Fog to burn off by nine, sun on the upper ridge by ten, mud below the gorge fold until further notice — pack accordingly, which Christine already has.

storyline_updates.title: The Table Awaits
storyline_updates.summary: Day 3: They have departed. The Jeep left at six forty-one; the waymarker at the gorge mouth was logged at seven fifty-two; the ridge fog cleared by eight. The table is empty; the household is in Lucy's capable and unaccountable hands. Day 4 — the final day — should bring them home: the Jeep returns with mud on the wheels, something new on the map (a second circle, a note, a name), and whatever the table hosts next. The arc should resolve warmly with the return itself — the Jeep in the drive, the dogs at the door, Steve with something to say about the trail, Christine with something already planned for Monday. Resolution should feel like a satisfying exhale.
